inattentional blindness occurs when a person is so focused on one thing, that he/she is unaware of other events that are taking place in his/her environment, even when those events are unexpected and unusual, and even when the person is looking directly at the unexpected event.

inattentional deaf is an effect that occurs in the auditory system, which can be caused by a variety of factors, including the presence of other stimuli that compete for attention, or by the lack of resources to attend to both auditory and other stimuli.
